newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields: 6-,9-mo down, 12-mo up.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields: 6-,9-mo down, 12-mo up.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six- and nine-month Ukraine discount treasury bills slipped and yields on 12-month bills rose from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.
Six-month bills edged down to 19.83 percent from 20.25 percent, nine-month bills eased to 28.26 percent from 28.54 percent, and 12-month bills rose to 30.85 percent from 28.28 percent.
The results of Thursday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15.00 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Amount sold 15.00 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.65 million UAH 13.62 million UAH
The central bank sold 150,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 38.00 million UAH 38.00 million UAH
Amount sold 38.00 million UAH 36.05 million UAH
Actual amount raised 31.37 million UAH 29.71 million UAH
The central bank sold 380,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 70.00 million UAH 60.00 million UAH
Amount sold 59.17 million UAH 60.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 45.25 million UAH 46.80 million UAH
The central bank sold 591,749 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
